identity:
At 1405 during a routine CRYPTIC FORGE test, mathematician A34 reported feeling "strange, I don't know what" and immediately afterwards all monitoring and testing equipment ceased transmitting.  Security responded immediately and found A34 uninjured inside the testing room, though they were forced to cut through the door since the electronic lock had failed.  Subsequent investigation of network footage revealed that when attempting to radiation-sterilize various vegetables, A34 had somehow triggered an electromagnetic pulse.  When interviewed after the incident, A34 stated that, "the energy just kept building and building and I guess it had to go somewhere."

Unfortunately, due to the lockdowns and the prohibitive cost, as well as the disruptions it would cause other experiments and daily operations in general, any form of electromagnetic hardening is impractical.  Dr. Al-Masri has floated the possibility of attempting to train other CRYPTIC FORGE mathematicians to provide a control in case of an EMP, but at the moment, this is only theoretical as no mathematician has demonstrated the conscious abilty to produce one.  I'm sorry to say that for the moment, all we can do is hope it doesn't happen again.
